title: WHAT IF YOU HAD THE MILLION DOLLAR BUTTON? 💰😱 (The Price of Greed)
description:
A polished mahogany box appears on your doorstep with a glowing blood-red button. Every press wires $1,000,000 cash directly into your bank account. The catch? A random human being somewhere on Earth loses 10 years of their life.

Surrounded by debt and unpaid bills, Pip tells himself: 'Just once.' One million buys the penthouse, but five million buys the yacht, and ten million buys the private jet. Over six months, Pip presses the button fifteen times.

Then the consequences come home. His younger brother collapses at dinner, with doctors delivering an impossible diagnosis: his organs aged 40 years overnight.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
💬 THE ULTIMATE MORAL TEST:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
The box offers one final choice before locking forever:
👉 Option A: "PRESS FOR $100,000,000 — Use the fortune to buy world-class experimental medicine."
👉 Option B: "SMASH THE BOX — Destroy the mechanism forever and live with the guilt."

Drop your choice in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
